title: What is an accordion component?
content: An accordion is a UI element used to expand and collapse sections of related content.

title: Why use an accordion?
content: It helps organize large amounts of content in a compact space.

title: Where is it commonly used?
content: FAQs, dashboards, settings pages, and mobile apps.

title: How does it work?
content: Clicking a header toggles visibility of its content section.

title: Can multiple sections be open?
content: Yes, depending on implementation rules, either single or multiple sections can stay open.

title: Is it mobile-friendly?
content: Yes, accordions are widely used in responsive and mobile-first designs.

title: What technologies support accordions?
content: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React, Angular, and Vue.

title: Are accordions accessible?
content: They can be made accessible using ARIA attributes and proper keyboard navigation.

title: What is the benefit of using accordions?
content: They improve user experience by reducing page clutter and improving readability.

title: Can animations be added?
content: Yes, smooth transitions can be added using CSS or JavaScript animations.
